newsitem.title: TURKEY: Tender for sale of Eregli stake to be issued soon.
newsitem.headline: Tender for sale of Eregli stake to be issued soon.

text.p: Turkey's Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan said a tender for the sale of a majority state-held stake in flat steel producer Eregli Demir ve Celik Fabrikalari would be issued soon after cabinet approval.

"The OYK (Higher Board of Privatisation) decision on Eregli Demir Celik's privatisation has been taken and after it becomes binding at today's cabinet meeting it (Eregli) will be rapidly put to tender," Erbakan told reporters ahead of the meeting.
The government holds a 51.66 percent stake in Eregli.

Bids for the block sale of the state share in Eregli were sought last year but the tender was cancelled in May 1996 to allow more time for potential investors to put in bids. Eight bids were received in the first tender opened in January 1995.
Erbakan said work was also advancing on other privatisation projects, which the government has prioritised to spearhead its efforts to raise badly needed revenues for the state's coffers.
Preparations were focusing on the centrepiece of the sell-off programme, Turk Telekom, along with the privatisation of ports, the Prime Minister said.
He said agreements on renting out power stations, targeted as a further source of revenues, are expected to be signed in January. He said the rent agreements would raise $10 billion.
